notes.title: "Ducks Galore" DLC and a Kickstarter on the horizon!
notes.content:
Duck friends,

There are many things to cover today!

New DLC

Two DLCs in such a short time?
Yes! We’re thrilled we pulled this off, especially since we're busier than ever working on two more duck games. (If you’re reading this, you already know about them and have added them to your wishlist, right? :menacingduck:)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295380/Placid_Plastic_Duck_Simulator__Ducks_Galore/


Secret Diorama Project

Now, let’s talk about something exciting in the physical realm of analog ducks...

The amazing folks at Mojito Studios—a board game producer—approached us with a wild idea: a DUCK DIORAMA called Placid Plastic Duck Studio. Could we say no? Of course not!

While nothing’s set in stone yet, they’ve already made a prototype (with water!), and they’re working on a Kickstarter campaign. If you’d like to help make this incredibly cool thing happen, head over to their presentation page to sign up as an interested backer: https://presale.mojitostudios.com/


The more people we can rally, the more likely it is this feverish vision will become a reality—so spread the word!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/6c35fa66a6f0ce3ba2fae0544aa40a8505ce9189.png

Game Update

Finally, we made the PC and console versions more consistent. This is a major update, so expect some differences from the usual build and possibly some minor bugs. If you find something is not working as intended, please use the bug reports section in Steam Discussions.

Known bug: Currently, the multiplayer saves are not working.

Good news is for the occasion, we managed to work on some quality-of-life improvements, such as:


 Controller Compatibility
 Revised UI
 Improved Performance - Graphics and CPU performance have been optimized
 Water Disappearance Bug Fix
 Other small things I forgot to take note of


We'll keep working to fix and improve what we can.

Until next update!

notes.title: THE CARDS ARE DRAWN: Placid Plastic Deck, Announced
notes.content:
My dear duckies,

It's been a few months since we last published news here. This was not a forgetful silence—rest assured, you've been in our minds ever since we posted the first announcement in 2022. Rather, it was a "calm before the storm" kind of silence. We've been busy, very busy, and to be honest, we'll be busy for a little longer.

And yet, we've never been so happy to be this busy because we are working on a new, unexpected ducky-deck game!

If you consider that good news, hold on to your chair because today is the day you can watch the announcement trailer of Placid Plastic Deck - A Quiet Quest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510020/Placid_Plastic_Deck__A_Quiet_Quest/

Go to our brand new Steam page and push that “Add to Wishlist” button.

Did you ever dream of a world where ducks rule the card tables? Where you collect duck cards? Where ducks talk to you?

As the nice flock of duck aficionados we all are, we can make dreams come true.

Together!

--

Further general PPDS news:


 we are working on porting the game to mobile, which will happen before the year ends (with a little surprise)
 we are working on porting the remaining DLCs on all consoles, this should happen around November
 we want to produce a new DLC, we are aiming at December
 SSD is in progress and pretty much in line with our timeline

notes.title: Limited Time Bundle Promotion and Merry Christmas
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34557/Idle_Game_Variety_Bundle/


Idle Games Variety Bundle
A celebration of the variety among idle games, which are sadly often not seen as "real" games. Check out how different the world of idle games can be and play these games or just watch how they play themselves and stare at them.

Cookie Clicker
Cookie Clicker is a game about making an absurd amount of cookies. To help you in this endeavor, you will recruit a wide variety of helpful cookie makers, like friendly Grandmas, Farms, Factories, and otherworldly Portals.

The Longing
An unusual mix of adventure and idle game. In utter loneliness deep below the surface, it's your task to wait for the awakening of your king... for 400 days.

Placid Plastic Duck Simulator
Just your favorite duck game.

-

And with that, let us wish you all a Merry Christmas! The holiday update is live and if you are new to the game you have some ducks to meet for a limited time!

notes.title: Vote for the ducks at the Steam Awards 2023!
notes.content:
My dear duckies,

It's fun to picture our ducks alongside games with bigger budgets and scope.

Even though we're small, we're a strong and caring community. So, why not try the impossible and aim for a nomination in the Steam Awards?

If you're reading this, go ahead and vote for PPDS in the Labor of Love category now!

After all, this year we added:

- A Halloween event
- More ducks with So Many Ducks
- One t-shirt
- A Birthday party
- A new location in Hippospace Download
- The Multiplayer
- Even more ducks with Duck Addiction
- The opening of TheDoor™

ːsmileduckː

Placid Plastic Duck Simulator is a Labor of Love like no other.

Because it's the love of our entire community.

notes.title: Public lobbies, Emojis, and Graphic Settings
notes.content:
Dear duckies,

The birthday party event was a success, and we are delighted that so many of you joined us in celebrating one year of Placid Plastic Duck Simulator! ːpartyduckː

Now, it's time to clean up around the pool and return to normalcy.

As we do that, we also want to seize the opportunity to introduce something new—something we promised and something you didn't expect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/f163215502fbd4694f699e190b70901f60434c0b.png

1. From now on, as you play in a multiplayer game, you'll be able to spam emojis and let other players know how you feel about that unexpected bump you just received.

Just press the scroll wheel on your mouse and choose the emoji you want. Cool uh? ːcoolduckː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/3001600b4aed594710dc213617da351839080927.png

2. Public Lobbies are now a thing. Set it to "public" as you create a room as a host, or click on the magnifying glass when you want to join a room instead. ːsteamhappyː

3. Graphic Settings. Yes, they are here. Set it to low and see how nice the game can be when it's not mining cryptocurrencies. ːmenacingduckː

And that's all for now.

More news, big news, after the month of August. Be ready!

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/3228973c8d8f1a77c0614a8b85d940359e9c3565.jpg

My duck friends,

Among the many things we could add to the game (graphic settings, anyone?), we decided to bring you the silliest of them all: the multiplayer!

Have you ever dreamed of being able to select a particular duck and just be it as you float happily with your friends? Now you can! (do nothing with your friends)

A total of 8 people can now join the pool, choose from the collection any duck they have previously unlocked, and hang out together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/093c0196e7fff096c698ee28a8a11d99c4db30dc.png

Do you all want to pick helicopter duck? Do that and see who is the last one to remain in the pool, for a real Battle Royal experience. Or, get one fire-breathing duck among wood ducks, and the last one to catch on fire wins. The possibilities are endless!

Since testing is still ongoing, this is a BETA, which means:

- only the base location is available
- the door is not active
- errors might occur
- be patient ːmenacingduckː

And that's all for today. A shoutout to all the ducks in the Discord server who read this, you are the best!

More news soon. ːcoolduckː 
(yes, graphic settings are also in the works)

QUACK!

notes.title: "Duck Addiction" DLC now available!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

Thanks to you the word about PPDS is spreading far and wide, so much so that a new flock of ducks decided to join in and they are now ready to meet you in your favorite pool!

So kick back, relax, and watch them as they do what they do best: floating. But expect some hiding, dancing, scanning, and other things.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303400/Placid_Plastic_Duck_Simulator__Duck_Addiction/

These new ducks are bringing with them 3 additional achievements. I know the vast majority of you like that, but bear in mind these ones require some... action, as sometimes happens in the game.

What else? Ah right, save slots. We promised we would add one additional save slot, one for each location. We added 6 instead! ːcoolduckː  (does that mean we'll eventually get to 6 locations? no. I don't know. maybe. ːnerdduckː)

We also added a little something we call a cinematic camera, which comes in handy when you leave the game open without interacting: the camera will automatically switch from duck to duck (or spot) after the game is left idle for a while. You can turn this function off from the settings.

Lastly, if you check the controls section, you'll notice how now you can stop the duck spawn by pressing Y.

To recap:
- 3 additional achievements
- 6 save slots
- cinematic camera
- Y to stop spawning ducks

And this is all for now.

As always, thank you for your support. The duck family keeps expanding, and as long as the word keeps spreading, more content will never cease to come!

notes.title: Most Relaxing Game: Help the ducks be nominated for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Duck friends,

A great prize is at hand! We have the opportunity to take Steam by storm with the power of plastic tranquillity, cuteness, and style. 

The Steam Awards nominations are now open, and if we all together bob along in the same direction, we can really make a difference.

People of the pool, beaks of stoicism and beauty, heed my call: let the QUACK be heard all over the world!

All we have to do is vote for the Sit back and relax category, and make sure we all vote for Placid Plastic Duck Simulator. The ducks will do the rest.

It's a long shot, true, but I'm confident we can make it.

Together!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/dbe2c17489306db1961dcfdec669a5d2c0433f0f.jpg


Now two words about what's coming next.

You don't think we are just sitting here idling watching the ducks float, right? Of course not. We are working to add more stuff to the game, and we have soooo many ideas in mind you can't imagine. Well, actually some of you can...

Long story short, there is a new AMAZING expansion coming up next month. This time is not going to be more ducks, but one additional location to play at!

It's going to be fun, thank you for sticking with us instead of flying away alone like Tim.

notes.title: "Ducks, Please" DLC official announcement
notes.content:
My duckies,

The first Placid Plastic Duck Simulator expansion  is on its way and will soon be with you all.

Wishlist it now!

After spending a very hot and relaxing month of August at the beach, we are back and ready to make all ideas (ours and yours) come true.

We've been monitoring your comments since the beginning, and after studying them closely, we produced convoluted diagrams and algorithms which gave us a very surprising result in terms of what was the top request: "more ducks".

Therefore, 27 additional and unique plastic ducks will join your collection thanks to the upcoming "Ducks, Please" DLC. As you would expect, some of them have specific interactions and behavior.

Here, have a glance at some of the new ducks you will meet:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/69c2e6e00b3b06410996338b1310e51cd46b49cf.jpg

In addition to new ducks, we are also bringing some quality of life updates and fixes:

- Save slot, so that you can now save your ducky progress.

- Settings panel, to be able to change resolution, play in windowed mode, and more.

- Quack sound upon clicking on a duck to select it (this might hide some surprises).

- Fixed the engine of the helicopter duck, so that it doesn't get stuck on the wall anymore.

- Ability to name the ducks and show their name both in-game and in your collection.

- Little adjustments we'll let you discover by yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/b78365e57e7b43a86efd31b3607abb5c6acd2f95.jpg

And here's what you can expect from this DLC:

- 27 new ducks

- new unique actions and combos

- increased relaxation

- support for further development

- the ducks' gratitude

- fireworks


Speaking of new DLCs, if all goes as planned, you should get ready for more fun environments to come!

To follow our progress as we keep adding new exciting but relaxing stuff to the game, follow us on our Twitter page.

For now, we hope you'll enjoy meeting up with all the new ducks.

notes.title: PPDuck Update 1.0.1 - Hotfix and Overwhelmingly Positive result!
notes.content:
Dear Duckies,

First of all, thank you! This many downloads and good reviews are as welcome as unexpected :).

It's now almost 10 days since release day; it's amazing to watch so many people playing and streaming and to read so many comments, reviews, and feedback.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/4b559343e0fe92e8d9ff80eeadc883f4a80d567e.png


We haven't been idle though, because we wanted to address the most common issues as soon as possible. This is just the first of many updates to come!

Before we get to the list of what we added and fixed, allow me to announce that you asked for trading cards and trading cards you'll get next week!

Enjoy this sneak peek:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/4e875b161f872fa10751df6297c32091c376b86d.jpg


Now, on to a more serious topic: the infamous GPU usage. Many people noticed this issue and rightfully complained. This week we investigated the problem and eventually managed to considerably reduce GPU usage and temperature, though we are still working on optimization. 

We want to do more and add video settings in another future update. This requires a bit more work, but rest assured it will be implemented, this way players will be able to adjust everything according to their setup.

FIXED

 Helicopter cap duck getting stuck on the floor
 Occlusion culling making the camera go through objects
 Ducks ending too often stranded out of the pool
 Golf ball achievement triggering randomly
 Fps and GPU usage
 Korean and Japanese languages


ADDED

 Simplified Chinese and Turkish languages


Brace yourself my duckies, for the best is yet to come.
